$comment: Pass 4 deterministic-floor fixture (VRFY-06, VRFY-23, D-20-29). Each paragraph's expected_orphans / expected_orphan_count follow the floor rule in bin/lib/verify/pass4.ts: split the paragraph into sentences (a . ! or ? — with any closing quote or bracket — followed by whitespace or the end, never inside a citation; a piece holding only citations joins the sentence before it); drop a sentence under 8 words (citations not counted), a question, or a definition (defined as / refers to / known as); a sentence is a claim (HIGH) with ONE strong marker — causal verb (cause(s|d), lead(s) to, result(s|ed) in, increase(s|d), decrease(s|d), reduce(s|d), improve(s|d), lower(s|ed), raise(s|d), drive(s), prevent(s|ed)), universal quantifier (every, all, always, never, no one, none), evidential verb in any inflection (show/shows/showed/shown, demonstrate(s|d), find(s)/found, report(s|ed), indicate(s|d), prove(s|d|n), reveal(s|ed), confirm(s|ed), establish(es|ed)), statistic or percentage (73%, 40 percent, per cent, N times, twice as), comparative change (more/less/higher/lower/greater/fewer than, rose, fell, doubled, tripled) — or TWO distinct weak markers (is, are, demonstrates, shows, proves, indicates, suggests, reveals, confirms, establishes, argues, claims, because, therefore, thus, hence, consequently); one weak marker alone is AMBIGUOUS and never counted by the floor. A HIGH claim is an orphan when the sentence itself carries no citation of any Pandoc form. The counts were derived by walking each paragraph through that rule by hand (the description of each case records the walk) and are re-checked, LLM-independent (PENSMITH_NO_LLM=1), by tests/known-bad-pass4.test.ts; after a rule change re-derive them the same way and review every changed count. The two register sentences are the audit's CORE-35 / SWP-82 examples.

cases.paragraph: The collected experimental data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity. Independent replication consequently confirms that the observed effect proves highly reproducible across laboratories.
expected_orphans: The collected experimental data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity.
Independent replication consequently confirms that the observed effect proves highly reproducible across laboratories.
cases.description: Two uncited claims. S1 (13 words): evidential verbs demonstrates, reveals → HIGH, no citation → orphan. S2 (13 words): evidential confirms, proves → HIGH, no citation → orphan.

cases.paragraph: The experimental data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity than the predicted baseline value here [@brown2020].
cases.description: Cited control: the one HIGH claim (evidential demonstrates) carries [@brown2020] in the sentence → not an orphan.

cases.paragraph: The experimental data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity than the predicted baseline value here.
expected_orphans: The experimental data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity than the predicted baseline value here.
cases.description: The same sentence without its citation → one orphan (isolates the sentence-level citation check).

cases.paragraph: Every HIGH claim in this paragraph carries its own citation marker. The data demonstrates that the catalyst reveals a stronger binding affinity than predicted [@brown2020]. A second run consequently confirms that the effect proves stable across replicates [@chen2019].
expected_orphans: Every HIGH claim in this paragraph carries its own citation marker.
cases.description: S1 (11 words) holds the universal quantifier Every → HIGH and carries no citation → orphan (the old rule needed two weak markers and a citation within 500 characters, so it gave 0). S2 and S3 are HIGH and each carries its own citation → not orphans.

cases.paragraph: Photosynthesis is defined as the biochemical conversion of light energy into stored chemical energy within plants.
cases.description: A definition (defined as) is not a claim.

cases.paragraph: Climate change demonstrates accelerating ice loss across both polar regions. This clearly proves that the climate feedback loop is intensifying rapidly. Ice sheets are retreating globally according to recent satellite measurements.
expected_orphans: Climate change demonstrates accelerating ice loss across both polar regions.
This clearly proves that the climate feedback loop is intensifying rapidly.
cases.description: The canonical paragraph. S1: evidential demonstrates (one strong marker is enough, D-20-29) → HIGH orphan (the old rule, which needed two markers, gave 1 for the paragraph). S2: evidential proves → HIGH orphan. S3: only the weak marker are → AMBIGUOUS, never counted by the floor.

cases.paragraph: Is the catalyst effective? The short fragment fails. The longer analysis demonstrates that the new catalyst reveals a substantially stronger binding affinity than the legacy reagent baseline.
expected_orphans: The longer analysis demonstrates that the new catalyst reveals a substantially stronger binding affinity than the legacy reagent baseline.
cases.description: S1 is a question, S2 has 4 words: neither is a claim. S3: evidential demonstrates → HIGH, uncited → orphan.

expected_orphans: Social media use clearly causes depression in every adolescent.
cases.description: Register sentence 1 (CORE-35 / SWP-82; the old rule counted 0): causal causes + universal every → HIGH, uncited → orphan.

Studies show that 73% of American cities saw street trees lower asthma hospitalizations by 40 percent.

cases.description: Every Pandoc form counts as a citation at sentence level: a narrative @smith2020 and a cluster [@lee2021; @park2019] → 0.

cases.paragraph: This review argues that attention is the dominant sequence architecture because it scales well and therefore displaces recurrence [@Vaswani2017].
cases.description: SWP-91: a mixed-case key is a citation (the old [@lowercase] regex made it a false orphan). Weak argues, is, because, therefore → HIGH, cited → 0.

cases.paragraph: Street trees lower asthma rates in every city studied so far. Other work agrees with this reading of the data [@lee2021].
expected_orphans: Street trees lower asthma rates in every city studied so far.
cases.description: A citation in the NEXT sentence does not cover a claim (the old 500-character proximity did): S1 causal lower + universal every → HIGH, uncited → orphan; S2 has no marker.

cases.paragraph: Street trees lower asthma rates in every city studied so far. [@lee2021]
cases.description: A citation left alone after the full stop joins its sentence → cited → 0.

cases.paragraph: Does social media use cause depression in every adolescent who uses it daily?
